meta.coverage_note: Only locally collected SEC records are exported; missing values remain missing.
meta.filing_date_semantics: filing_date and available_at use verified SEC acceptance time; sec_filed_date is the SEC filing date.
meta.financial_lookback_note: Earlier disclosed periods are retained as backtest warmup inputs; the requested decision window is not a claim of complete coverage.
meta.additional_fields_basis: Exact reported SEC tags. Cash-flow durations may be year-to-date; retain period_start/period_end. Cash dividends paid are not a dividend announcement or revision event chain.
